newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Coffee seen heading for new heights.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Coffee seen heading for new heights.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE coffee is heading for another day of sharp rises, and the strength could follow through into next week, technical analysts said on Friday.
Traders were looking for a Friday opening $100 higher.
"Technicals still point strongly higher," Trevor Neil, senior analyst at Union CAL Ltd, said.
"There's hardly any resistance. It's clear blue sky," he said. He put the objective of the current rally at $2,150.
"Technically, when there is a setback, there is support at $1,860, with major support at $1,810," he said.
LIFFE robusta coffee futures charged sharply higher in late Thursday trading, lifting benchmark July to a new one-year high of $1,940 a tonne on renewed fund buying.
Fund stop-loss buying was triggered as prices crossed the $1,900 mark, traders said. By the close, July stood at $1,933, still a sharp $63 gain on the day.
New York coffee futures staged a dizzying rally on Thursday as speculators led a broad-based buying frenzy amid a background of tight supply, traders said.
